## Welcome to Predictive Risk Corp
Predictive Risk Corp Private Limited, located at 450 Cyber Square, Gurugram, Haryana, operates as a notified Significant Data Fiduciary providing automated credit and behavioral scoring solutions.

## Automated Algorithmic Profiling
Predictive Risk Corp Private Limited affirmatively deploys entirely autonomous, black-box algorithmic profiling engines that continuously evaluate and score user financial behavior to deny credit lines without human review, explicitly bypassing any periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments or algorithmic risk audits.

## Data Security and Logging
To ensure system reliability, we maintain secure internal server logs of all user account modifications for ninety days. Users retain the right to contact our grievance officer regarding account queries.
